title: Sussur Tree Bark
summary: Quest material for forging one Sussur weapon.

fields.Forge: Use the bark at the Blacksmith’s Forge with a normal dagger, sickle or greatsword. Only one is made. Completing the weapon awards The Finest Ingredients to Guild Artisans.
fields.Acquisition: Large Sussur Tree in Dread Hollow at (−14, −138).

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
